verdict.rationale: CrewAI AMP documents a REST API for deployed crews, with endpoints such as POST /kickoff, GET /status/{kickoff_id} and POST /resume. However, the evidence only shows these as human-readable markdown reference pages, and a probe of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404 on every one. The llms.txt index makes the docs machine-readable, but it is not an API spec, so there is no evidence of a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent specification.
